text: ok next i want you to create what will be used as an in-app file exploring menu, rather than procing for the systems menu to search for imports etc. i want it to be baked in and have history so that we can reduce the amount of time searching for things and more time working
resolution: Added an in-app project file explorer to the hmsc workspace mock. The File menu now includes project explorer/import-source commands and Open Workspace routes into the same baked-in explorer. The explorer uses mock indexed project data, folder navigation, path/import/tag search, selected-file preview, fixed result rows, and clickable file history. Documented the direction in DESIGN_INTAKE. Also updated v8_bindings_core to match the current dirty DecimatedMesh return shape so the cart can build.
